tables.name: orders
tables.description: One row per storefront order, subscription box shipments included.

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: Line items. One row per product on an order.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Registered customers. Guests are written here on their first order.

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.description: The seasonal gear box. One row per subscription, current state only.

tables.name: subscription_events
tables.description: Append only log of plan changes, pauses, cancellations and reactivations.

tables.name: payments
tables.description: Authorisations and captures from the two payment processors.

tables.name: products
tables.description: Catalogue, one row per sellable SKU.

tables.name: inventory
tables.description: Stock position per SKU per warehouse, refreshed every 15 minutes.

tables.name: sessions
tables.description: Web and app sessions from the tracking pipeline.

tables.name: events
tables.description: Raw product analytics stream. Partitioned by day, queried rarely.

tables.name: ad_spend
tables.description: Daily spend per campaign, loaded from the ad platforms every morning.

tables.name: orders_backup_2023
tables.description: Snapshot taken before the 2024 replatform. Nobody has dropped it.

tables.name: fct_orders
tables.description: Order grain fact table. The one the finance team reconciles against.

tables.name: fct_revenue_daily
tables.description: Revenue by day and channel. Renamed from fct_revenue in March 2026.

tables.name: fct_subscription_mrr
tables.description: One row per subscription per month, with the MRR recognised that month.

tables.name: int_subscription_periods
tables.description: Intermediate model: one row per billed period per subscription.

cards.name: E-commerce Insights, Sample Question
cards.sql: SELECT CATEGORY, count(*) AS COUNT FROM PRODUCTS GROUP BY CATEGORY

cards.name: Black Friday 2024 hourly sales
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', o.placed_at) AS hour, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.placed_at BETWEEN '2024-11-29' AND '2024-12-02'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: 2023 KPI sheet (superseded)
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', placed_at) AS month, count(*) AS orders, sum(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Daily order count (schema qualified)
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', placed_at) AS order_day, count(*) AS orders
FROM "public"."orders"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Search to purchase rate
cards.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_name = 'search_performed') AS searched,
       count(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_name = 'order_completed') AS purchased
FROM events e
WHERE e.occurred_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'

cards.name: Email capture rate by device
cards.sql:
SELECT s.device_type,
       count(DISTINCT s.id) AS sessions,
       count(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_name = 'email_captured') AS captures
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN events e ON e.session_id = s.id
WHERE s.started_at >= current_date - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: MRR
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at) AS month,
       sum(sum(e.mrr_delta)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at)) AS running_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Orders per customer distribution
cards.sql:
SELECT d.lifetime_orders,
       count(*) AS customers
FROM dbt_marts.dim_customers d
WHERE d.lifetime_orders > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Reopened tickets share
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', t.opened_at) AS month,
       count(*) AS tickets,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.reopened_count > 0) AS reopened,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.reopened_count > 0) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS reopened_pct
FROM support_tickets t
WHERE t.opened_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Net revenue by day, last 90 days
cards.description: Gross and net revenue per day, cancellations and fraud excluded. The number Finance reports.
cards.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', o.placed_at) AS order_day,
  count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
  sum(o.total_amount) AS gross_revenue,
  sum(o.total_amount - o.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
  AND o.placed_at >= '2026-06-18'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Campaign performance, last 28 days
cards.description: Spend, clicks and click through rate per campaign for the last four weeks.
cards.sql:
SELECT c.name,
       c.platform,
       sum(a.impressions) AS impressions,
       sum(a.clicks) AS clicks,
       sum(a.spend_amount) AS spend,
       round(100.0 * sum(a.clicks) / nullif(sum(a.impressions), 0), 2) AS ctr_pct
FROM ad_spend a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.spend_date >= current_date - interval '28 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 5 DESC

cards.name: Payment failures by processor
cards.description: Declines and errors per processor, with the failure codes behind them.
cards.sql:
SELECT p.processor,
       p.failure_code,
       count(*) AS failures,
       sum(p.amount) AS amount_at_risk
FROM payments p
WHERE p.status = 'failed'
  AND p.created_at >= current_date - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: Cohort retention by signup month
cards.description: Classic triangle. Month 0 is the signup month.
cards.sql:
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
         date_trunc('month', c.created_at) AS cohort_month
  FROM customers c
  WHERE c.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
)
SELECT cohorts.cohort_month,
       extract(month FROM age(o.placed_at, cohorts.cohort_month)) AS months_since_signup,
       count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
FROM cohorts
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cohorts.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2

cards.name: Revenue recognized vs cash collected
cards.sql:
WITH recognized AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', r.revenue_date) AS month, sum(r.net_revenue) AS recognized
  FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
  GROUP BY 1
), collected AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', p.captured_at) AS month, sum(p.amount) AS collected
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.status = 'captured'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT recognized.month, recognized.recognized, collected.collected,
       recognized.recognized - collected.collected AS gap
FROM recognized
JOIN collected ON collected.month = recognized.month
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Backordered units by week
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', o.placed_at) AS week_start,
       sum(oi.quantity) AS backordered_units
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE i.on_hand < oi.quantity
  AND o.status = 'awaiting_stock'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Weekly Revenue
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', o.placed_at) AS week_start,
       sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '1 year'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Repeat purchase rate within 60 days
cards.sql:
WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, min(o.placed_at) AS first_at
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', first_orders.first_at) AS cohort_month,
       count(*) AS customers,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.placed_at <= first_orders.first_at + interval '60 days' AND o.placed_at > first_orders.first_at) AS repeated
FROM first_orders
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = first_orders.customer_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Trial share of new revenue
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', s.started_at) AS month,
       sum(s.mrr_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL) AS "Revenue from Trials",
       sum(s.mrr_amount) AS "Revenue from All Plans"
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.started_at >= '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: CAC payback by cohort month
cards.description: Months of gross margin needed to earn back acquisition cost.
cards.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', c.first_order_at) AS cohort_month,
         count(*) AS customers,
         sum(d.lifetime_revenue) AS revenue
  FROM customers c
  JOIN dbt_marts.dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE c.first_order_at >= '2024-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), spend AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS cohort_month, sum(a.spend_amount) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend a
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cohort.cohort_month,
       cohort.customers,
       round(spend.spend / nullif(cohort.customers, 0), 2) AS cac,
       round(cohort.revenue / nullif(cohort.customers, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM cohort
JOIN spend ON spend.cohort_month = cohort.cohort_month
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: New subscribers by plan (weekly)
cards.description: New paid subscriptions and the MRR they bring, by plan and week.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', s.started_at) AS week_start,
       s.plan_code,
       count(*) AS new_subscribers,
       sum(s.mrr_amount) AS new_mrr
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.started_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND s.status <> 'trialing'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

cards.name: Gross margin by month
cards.description: Revenue less product cost, from line items and the product catalogue.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.placed_at) AS month,
       sum(oi.line_total) AS revenue,
       sum(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS product_cost,
       round(100.0 * (sum(oi.line_total) - sum(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) / nullif(sum(oi.line_total), 0), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
  AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Stockouts by product category
cards.description: SKUs with nothing on hand, grouped by category.
cards.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.on_hand = 0) AS stocked_out_skus,
       count(*) AS skus
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE p.is_active
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Deferred revenue from annual plans
cards.sql:
SELECT s.plan_code,
       count(*) AS annual_subscriptions,
       sum(s.mrr_amount * 12) AS billed_amount,
       sum(s.mrr_amount * extract(month FROM age(s.current_period_end, current_date))) AS deferred_amount
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.billing_interval = 'annual'
  AND s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: MRR movement (new, expansion, churn)
cards.description: The waterfall behind the MRR line. Expansion counts plan upgrades only.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at) AS month,
       sum(e.mrr_delta) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'created') AS new_mrr,
       sum(e.mrr_delta) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'upgraded') AS expansion_mrr,
       sum(e.mrr_delta) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN ('downgraded', 'cancelled')) AS churned_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
WHERE e.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Churn Rate
cards.description: Cancelled subscriptions over active ones at the start of the month.
cards.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', s.cancelled_at) AS month,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelled,
         count(*) AS total
  FROM subscriptions s
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       cancelled,
       total,
       round(100.0 * cancelled / nullif(total, 0), 2) AS churn_pct
FROM monthly
WHERE month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Refund rate by product category, trailing 30d
cards.description: Refunded amount over sold amount per category. Merchandising reviews this every Thursday.
cards.sql:
WITH refunded AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id, sum(r.amount) AS refunded_amount
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  WHERE r.refunded_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.category,
       sum(oi.line_total) AS sold_amount,
       coalesce(sum(refunded.refunded_amount), 0) AS refunded_amount,
       round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(refunded.refunded_amount), 0) / nullif(sum(oi.line_total), 0), 2) AS refund_rate_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN refunded ON refunded.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.created_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

cards.name: test query please ignore
cards.sql: SELECT * FROM zz_test LIMIT 10

cards.name: Top products by units sold, last 90 days
cards.description: Units and revenue per SKU. Feeds the restock conversation.
cards.sql:
SELECT p.sku,
       p.title,
       p.category,
       sum(oi.quantity) AS units,
       sum(oi.line_total) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 50

cards.name: Support tickets per 1k orders
cards.description: Contact rate. Support uses it to argue for headcount, Ops uses it to argue about packaging.
cards.sql:
WITH monthly_tickets AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', t.opened_at) AS month, count(*) AS tickets
  FROM support_tickets t
  GROUP BY 1
), monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.placed_at) AS month, count(*) AS orders
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT monthly_tickets.month,
       monthly_tickets.tickets,
       monthly_orders.orders,
       round(1000.0 * monthly_tickets.tickets / nullif(monthly_orders.orders, 0), 1) AS tickets_per_1k_orders
FROM monthly_tickets
JOIN monthly_orders ON monthly_orders.month = monthly_tickets.month
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Paid vs organic revenue split
cards.description: Paid covers search, social and display. Everything else counts as organic.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', f.order_date) AS week_start,
       CASE WHEN f.channel IN ('paid_search', 'paid_social', 'display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'organic' END AS bucket,
       sum(f.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders f
WHERE f.order_date >= current_date - interval '6 months'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Inventory below reorder point
cards.description: Anything at or under its reorder point, worst first. Checked every morning.
cards.sql:
SELECT p.sku,
       p.title,
       i.warehouse_code,
       i.on_hand,
       i.reserved,
       i.reorder_point,
       i.on_hand - i.reserved AS available
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE i.on_hand - i.reserved <= i.reorder_point
  AND p.is_active
ORDER BY 7

cards.name: Orders per day with empty days filled in
cards.sql:
SELECT day::date AS order_day,
       coalesce(count(o.id), 0) AS orders
FROM generate_series (date '2026-06-01', date '2026-09-15', interval '1 day') AS day
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.placed_at::date = day::date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Ad spend vs new customers by channel
cards.description: Monthly spend against acquired customers, with blended CAC per channel.
cards.sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT a.channel, date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS month, sum(a.spend_amount) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend a
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), acquired AS (
  SELECT c.signup_source AS channel, date_trunc('month', c.created_at) AS month, count(*) AS customers
  FROM customers c
  WHERE c.first_order_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT spend.month,
       spend.channel,
       spend.spend,
       acquired.customers,
       round(spend.spend / nullif(acquired.customers, 0), 2) AS cac
FROM spend
LEFT JOIN acquired ON acquired.channel = spend.channel AND acquired.month = spend.month
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Customer 360
cards.description: Curated model: one row per customer with orders, subscription state and support history.
cards.sql:
SELECT d.customer_id,
       d.email,
       d.country,
       d.lifetime_orders,
       d.lifetime_revenue,
       d.current_plan,
       count(t.id) AS support_tickets
FROM dbt_marts.dim_customers d
LEFT JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = d.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6

cards.name: Subscriptions imported from the old billing system
cards.sql:
SELECT ls.customer_id,
       ls.plan_name,
       ls.started_at,
       c.email
FROM legacy_subscriptions ls
JOIN customers c ON c.id = ls.customer_id
WHERE ls.migrated_at IS NULL

cards.name: Tax collected by state, quarterly
cards.description: Filing support. Do not change the rounding without asking Finance.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.placed_at) AS quarter,
       c.state,
       sum(o.tax_amount) AS tax_collected,
       count(*) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'US'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Session to order conversion by device
cards.description: Sessions that turned into an order within a day, split by device.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.device_type,
       count(DISTINCT s.id) AS sessions,
       count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT o.id) / nullif(count(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
 AND o.placed_at BETWEEN s.started_at AND s.started_at + interval '1 day'
WHERE s.started_at >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Discount leakage by coupon code
cards.description: Which codes are still live and what they cost per order.
cards.sql:
SELECT o.coupon_code,
       count(*) AS orders,
       sum(o.discount_amount) AS discount_given,
       round(avg(o.discount_amount / nullif(o.subtotal_amount, 0)) * 100, 1) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM orders o
WHERE o.coupon_code IS NOT NULL
  AND o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) > 25
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: Time to first response, minutes
cards.description: Median and 90th percentile of the wait before a customer hears back.
cards.sql:
SELECT t.priority,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM t.first_response_at - t.opened_at) / 60)) AS p50_minutes,
       round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM t.first_response_at - t.opened_at) / 60)) AS p90_minutes,
       count(*) AS tickets
FROM support_tickets t
WHERE t.first_response_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.opened_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: Plan mix over time
cards.description: Subscriptions and MRR per plan, month by month.
cards.sql:
SELECT m.month_start,
       m.plan_code,
       count(DISTINCT m.subscription_id) AS subscriptions,
       sum(m.mrr_amount) AS mrr
FROM dbt_marts.fct_subscription_mrr m
WHERE m.is_active
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

cards.name: Rows loaded today, orders
cards.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS rows_loaded
FROM "public"."orders"
WHERE updated_at >= current_date

cards.name: Weekly digest numbers
cards.description: Feeds the Monday email. Do not rename, the script looks it up by name.
cards.sql:
SELECT sum(r.net_revenue) AS net_revenue,
       sum(r.orders_count) AS orders,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status = 'active') AS active_subscriptions
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
WHERE r.revenue_date >= current_date - interval '7 days'

cards.name: Renewal rate by billing period
cards.description: How many subscriptions survive each renewal, by period index.
cards.sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT p.subscription_id,
         p.period_index,
         p.was_renewed
  FROM dbt_marts.int_subscription_periods p
  WHERE p.period_start >= date '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT periods.period_index,
       count(*) AS periods_started,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE periods.was_renewed) AS renewed,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE periods.was_renewed) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS renewal_pct
FROM periods
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.id = periods.subscription_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Trials expiring in the next seven days
Daily net revenue (mart)
cards.description: Board version of the daily revenue line.
cards.sql:
SELECT r.revenue_date,
       r.channel,
       r.net_revenue
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue r
WHERE r.revenue_date >= current_date - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: NPS detractor comments, last 30 days
cards.sql:
SELECT n.responded_at,
       n.score,
       n.survey_channel,
       n.comment
FROM nps_responses n
WHERE n.score <= 6
  AND n.comment IS NOT NULL
  AND n.responded_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Revenue by store region, trailing 12 months
cards.description: Where the revenue comes from. Regions follow the warehouse map, not the shipping address.
cards.sql:
SELECT f.store_region,
       sum(f.net_revenue) AS net_revenue,
       count(*) AS orders
FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders f
WHERE f.order_date >= current_date - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Reactivations per month
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at) AS month,
       count(*) AS reactivations,
       sum(e.mrr_delta) AS recovered_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'reactivated'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: CAC by channel (working copy)
cards.sql:
with spend as (
  select a.channel, date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) as month, sum(a.spend_amount) as spend
  from ad_spend a group by 1, 2
), acquired as (
  select c.signup_source as channel, date_trunc('month', c.created_at) as month, count(*) as customers
  from customers c where c.first_order_at is not null group by 1, 2
)
select spend.month, spend.channel, spend.spend, acquired.customers,
       round(spend.spend / nullif(acquired.customers, 0), 2) as cac
from spend
left join acquired on acquired.channel = spend.channel and acquired.month = spend.month
order by 1 desc, 3 desc

cards.name: Net revenue by day (copy)
cards.sql:
-- copied from Dana, keep in sync with the Finance version
select date_trunc('day', o.placed_at) as order_day,
       count(distinct o.id) as orders,
       sum(o.total_amount) as gross_revenue,
       sum(o.total_amount - o.discount_amount) as net_revenue
  from orders o
 where o.status not in ('cancelled', 'fraud')
   and o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01'
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

cards.name: new_subscribers_by_plan_v2
cards.sql:
-- for the growth review, do not edit
select date_trunc('week', s.started_at) as week_start, s.plan_code, count(*) as new_subscribers, sum(s.mrr_amount) as new_mrr
from subscriptions s
where s.started_at >= '2024-06-01' and s.status <> 'trialing'
group by 1, 2
order by 1 desc, 4 desc

cards.name: Top SKUs for merchandising
cards.sql:
-- merchandising asked for this one, same as the ops version
SELECT
  p.sku, p.title, p.category,
  sum(oi.quantity) AS units,
  sum(oi.line_total) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '180 days'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 100

cards.name: Refund rate by category (2025 version)
cards.sql:
with refunded as (select oi.product_id, sum(r.amount) as refunded_amount
from refunds r
join orders o on o.id = r.order_id
join order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id
where r.refunded_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
group by 1)
select p.category, sum(oi.line_total) as sold_amount, coalesce(sum(refunded.refunded_amount), 0) as refunded_amount,
round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(refunded.refunded_amount), 0) / nullif(sum(oi.line_total), 0), 2) as refund_rate_pct
from order_items oi
join products p on p.id = oi.product_id
left join refunded on refunded.product_id = oi.product_id
where oi.created_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
group by 1
order by 4 desc

cards.name: Order lines with product attributes
cards.description: Curated model: line items joined to the product dimension, for ad hoc analysis.
cards.sql:
SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id,
       oi.order_id,
       o.placed_at,
       o.channel,
       p.category,
       p.brand,
       oi.quantity,
       oi.line_total
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN dbt_marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

cards.name: New subscribers by plan (copy)
cards.sql:
SELECT
    date_trunc('week', s.started_at) AS week_start,
    s.plan_code,
    count(*) AS new_subscribers,
    sum(s.mrr_amount) AS new_mrr
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.started_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.status <> 'trialing'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

cards.name: Sessions by device and week
cards.description: Session counts by device, twelve weeks back.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', s.started_at) AS week_start,
       s.device_type,
       count(*) AS sessions
FROM sessions s
WHERE s.started_at >= current_date - interval '12 weeks'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Weekly active subscribers
cards.description: The north star: subscribers who received or opened a box in the week.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', o.placed_at) AS week_start,
       count(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS active_subscribers
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '26 weeks'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Add to cart to checkout drop-off
cards.description: Where the funnel loses people between the cart and the payment step.
cards.sql:
SELECT e.event_name,
       count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS sessions
FROM events e
WHERE e.event_name IN ('product_viewed', 'add_to_cart', 'checkout_started', 'payment_submitted')
  AND e.occurred_at >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Revenue by month (2022 close)
cards.description: Kept for the 2022 audit trail.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', placed_at) AS month,
       sum(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders_2022
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Landing page to signup conversion
cards.description: Sessions that ended in a new account, by the page the visitor landed on.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.landing_path,
       count(DISTINCT s.id) AS sessions,
       count(DISTINCT c.id) AS signups,
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT c.id) / nullif(count(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2) AS signup_pct
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id AND c.created_at::date = s.started_at::date
WHERE s.started_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(DISTINCT s.id) > 500
ORDER BY 4 DESC

cards.name: Mart freshness check
cards.description: Latest date present in each mart. The dbt job opens this after every run.
cards.sql:
SELECT 'fct_revenue_daily' AS model, max(r.revenue_date)::text AS latest
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fct_orders', max(f.order_date)::text
FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders f
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fct_subscription_mrr', max(m.month_start)::text
FROM dbt_marts.fct_subscription_mrr m

cards.name: Shipping cost per order by service level
cards.description: What each service level costs us per shipment, last 90 days.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.service_level,
       count(*) AS shipments,
       round(avg(s.cost_amount), 2) AS avg_cost,
       round(sum(s.cost_amount), 2) AS total_cost
FROM shipments s
WHERE s.shipped_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

cards.name: Best sellers, last 30 days
cards.sql:
select p.sku, p.title, p.category, sum(oi.quantity) as units, sum(oi.line_total) as revenue
from order_items oi
join products p on p.id = oi.product_id
join orders o on o.id = oi.order_id
where o.placed_at >= current_date - interval '30 days' and o.status not in ('cancelled', 'fraud')
group by 1, 2, 3
order by 4 desc
limit 25

cards.name: Active Subscribers
cards.description: Paying subscribers, trials excluded.
cards.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS active_subscribers
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND s.trial_ends_at < now()

cards.name: Churn rate
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at) AS month,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'cancelled') AS cancellations,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'reactivated') AS reactivations
FROM subscription_events e
WHERE e.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Revenue run rate
cards.description: Trailing 90 days annualised. The number that goes in the board deck.
cards.sql:
SELECT round(sum(r.net_revenue) * 4, 2) AS annualised_run_rate
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
WHERE r.revenue_date >= current_date - interval '90 days'

cards.name: Customers by country and state
cards.sql:
SELECT c.country,
       c.state,
       count(*) AS customers,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.first_order_at IS NOT NULL) AS buyers
FROM customers c
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: Churned MRR by plan, last 6 months
cards.sql:
SELECT e.from_plan,
       date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at) AS month,
       sum(abs(e.mrr_delta)) AS churned_mrr
FROM subscription_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'cancelled'
  AND e.occurred_at >= current_date - interval '6 months'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Ad spend efficiency by platform
cards.sql:
SELECT a.platform,
       sum(a.spend_amount) AS spend,
       sum(a.clicks) AS clicks,
       round(sum(a.spend_amount) / nullif(sum(a.clicks), 0), 2) AS cost_per_click
FROM ad_spend a
WHERE a.spend_date >= current_date - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: First order value by acquisition source
cards.sql:
SELECT d.signup_source,
       count(*) AS customers,
       round(avg(f.gross_revenue), 2) AS avg_first_order
FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders f
JOIN dbt_marts.dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = f.customer_id
WHERE f.is_first_order
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: SKU spot check for the Tuesday call
cards.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.title, p.list_price, i.on_hand
FROM products p
JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.sku IN ('NW-TENT-2P', 'NW-BAG-45L', 'NW-STOVE-TI')

cards.name: Rows loaded today, customers
cards.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS rows_loaded
FROM "public"."customers"
WHERE updated_at >= current_date

cards.name: Daily revenue for standup
cards.sql:
/* standup version, same numbers as Finance runs on Monday */
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', o.placed_at) AS order_day, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gross_revenue, SUM(o.total_amount - o.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud') AND o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Customers with more than five orders
Contact rate per 1k orders (Ops)
cards.sql:
with monthly_tickets as (
    select date_trunc('month', t.opened_at) as month, count(*) as tickets
    from support_tickets t
    group by 1
),
monthly_orders as (
    select date_trunc('month', o.placed_at) as month, count(*) as orders
    from orders o
    group by 1
)
select monthly_tickets.month, monthly_tickets.tickets, monthly_orders.orders,
       round(1000.0 * monthly_tickets.tickets / nullif(monthly_orders.orders, 0), 1) as tickets_per_1k_orders
from monthly_tickets
join monthly_orders on monthly_orders.month = monthly_tickets.month
order by 1 desc

cards.name: Trial starts by week
cards.description: Trials opened per week. The conversion question sits next to it.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', s.started_at) AS week_start,
       count(*) AS trials_started
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL
  AND s.started_at >= current_date - interval '1 year'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Order volume excluding gifts, weekly
cards.description: Gift orders are billed differently, so they are left out of the volume line.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', o.placed_at) AS week_start,
       count(*) AS orders,
       sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.is_gift IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Event volume by name, last 7 days
cards.sql:
SELECT e.event_name,
       count(*) AS events,
       count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS sessions
FROM events e
WHERE e.occurred_at >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 30

cards.name: Order items for the packaging test
Copy of New subscribers by plan
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', s.started_at) AS week_start, s.plan_code, count(*) AS new_subscribers, sum(s.mrr_amount) AS new_mrr
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.started_at >= '2023-01-01'
  AND s.status <> 'trialing'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

cards.name: Open support tickets
cards.description: Everything not resolved, oldest first.

cards.name: Support tickets by customer tier
cards.description: Ticket volume split by lifetime value tier.
cards.sql:
SELECT ltv.tier,
       count(t.id) AS tickets,
       round(avg(t.reopened_count), 2) AS avg_reopens
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN customer_ltv_mart ltv ON ltv.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.opened_at >= current_date - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Tickets by category, weekly
cards.description: Volume per category. Shipping questions spike whenever a carrier misses a promise.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', t.opened_at) AS week_start,
       t.category,
       count(*) AS tickets
FROM support_tickets t
WHERE t.opened_at >= current_date - interval '16 weeks'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Tickets per agent, last 30 days
cards.description: Volume and average time to resolve per agent.
cards.sql:
SELECT t.assigned_to,
       count(*) AS tickets,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS resolved,
       round(avg(EXTRACT(epoch FROM t.resolved_at - t.opened_at) / 3600), 1) AS avg_hours_to_resolve
FROM support_tickets t
WHERE t.opened_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Device conversion (rebuilt after tracking fix)
cards.sql:
/* rebuilt after the tracking fix, numbers match the growth version */
SELECT s.device_type, count(DISTINCT s.id) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
  round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT o.id) / nullif(count(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id AND o.placed_at BETWEEN s.started_at AND s.started_at + interval '1 day'
WHERE s.started_at >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Weekly Revenue
cards.description: Net revenue by ISO week from the daily revenue mart.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', r.revenue_date) AS week_start,
       sum(r.gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
       sum(r.refund_amount) AS refunds,
       sum(r.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
WHERE r.revenue_date >= current_date - interval '26 weeks'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: New customers by acquisition source (monthly)
cards.description: First order counts as acquisition. Matches the CAC model.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.first_order_at) AS month,
       c.signup_source,
       count(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers c
WHERE c.first_order_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC

cards.name: Refunds issued by reason, last 12 months
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', r.refunded_at) AS month,
       r.reason,
       count(*) AS refunds,
       sum(r.amount) AS refunded_amount
FROM refunds r
WHERE r.refunded_at >= current_date - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

cards.name: Row count delta, orders vs fct_orders
cards.sql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) AS source_rows,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders) AS mart_rows,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) - (SELECT count(*) FROM dbt_marts.fct_orders) AS delta

cards.name: Ticket backlog by day
cards.description: Open and resolved tickets per day. Used in the Monday support standup.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', t.opened_at) AS day,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('open', 'pending')) AS open_tickets,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS resolved_tickets
FROM support_tickets t
WHERE t.opened_at >= current_date - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Late deliveries by carrier
cards.description: Deliveries that arrived after the promised date, by carrier and service level.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.carrier,
       s.service_level,
       count(*) AS deliveries,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivered_at > s.promised_at) AS late,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivered_at > s.promised_at) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS late_pct
FROM shipments s
WHERE s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND s.shipped_at >= current_date - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 5 DESC

cards.name: Trial to paid conversion by plan
cards.description: Share of trials that billed at least once, by plan.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.plan_code,
       count(*) AS trials,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status IN ('active', 'past_due')) AS converted,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status IN ('active', 'past_due')) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS conversion_pct
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL
  AND s.trial_ends_at < current_date
  AND s.started_at >= '2025-06-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

cards.name: Duplicate customer emails
cards.sql:
SELECT lower(c.email) AS email, count(*) AS accounts
FROM customers c
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Fulfillment lead time, p50 and p90
cards.sql:
SELECT s.warehouse_code,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.shipped_at - o.placed_at) / 3600), 1) AS p50_hours,
       round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(epoch FROM s.shipped_at - o.placed_at) / 3600), 1) AS p90_hours
FROM shipments s
JOIN orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
WHERE s.shipped_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC

cards.name: Orders shipped same day, by warehouse
cards.description: Share of orders that leave the building the day they are placed.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.warehouse_code,
       count(*) AS shipments,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_at::date = o.placed_at::date) AS same_day,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_at::date = o.placed_at::date) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS same_day_pct
FROM shipments s
JOIN orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
WHERE s.shipped_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

cards.name: Active subscriptions by billing interval
cards.description: Monthly against annual, in subscriptions and in MRR.
cards.sql:
SELECT s.billing_interval,
       count(*) AS subscriptions,
       sum(s.mrr_amount) AS mrr
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Daily order count
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', placed_at) AS order_day, count(*) AS orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: Orders by channel
cards.description: Order counts per acquisition channel from the order fact table.

cards.name: MRR
cards.description: Same metric read straight off the subscriptions table. Finance prefers this one at close.
cards.sql:
SELECT sum(s.mrr_amount) AS mrr,
       count(*) AS active_subscriptions
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status IN ('active', 'past_due')

cards.name: NPS by month
cards.description: Promoters minus detractors, per month. Responses come from the post delivery survey.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', n.responded_at) AS month,
       count(*) AS responses,
       round(100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.score >= 9) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.score <= 6)) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS nps
FROM nps_responses n
WHERE n.responded_at >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

cards.name: MRR
cards.description: Monthly recurring revenue from the subscription mart. The board number.
cards.sql:
SELECT m.month_start,
       sum(m.mrr_amount) AS mrr
FROM dbt_marts.fct_subscription_mrr m
WHERE m.is_active
  AND m.month_start >= date '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Average order value by month
cards.description: AOV on completed orders. Subscription boxes are counted as orders.
cards.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.placed_at) AS month,
       count(*) AS orders,
       round(avg(o.total_amount), 2) AS aov,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.total_amount), 2) AS median_order
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'fraud')
  AND o.placed_at >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Net revenue by channel, month to date
cards.description: Channel split for the current month, straight from the daily revenue mart.
cards.sql:
SELECT r.channel,
       sum(r.gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
       sum(r.refund_amount) AS refunds,
       sum(r.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
FROM dbt_marts.fct_revenue_daily r
WHERE r.revenue_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC
